title: The cosine law余弦定理

slides.h:
📐 Trigonometry三角

The cosine law余弦定理

A boat sails 30 km, turns, and sails 45 km more. How far is it from port? You know two sides and the angle between them — the sine law cannot start, but the cosine law finishes it in one line.一艘船航行 30 km 后转向，又航行 45 km。它离港口多远？你知道两条边和它们的夹角——正弦定理开不了头，余弦定理一行就解决。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 40 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · The cosine law余弦定理
  1. c2=a2+b2−2abcosC (c opposite C); C=90∘ gives Pythagoras.c2=a2+b2−2abcosC（c 对角 C）；C=90∘ 时就是勾股定理。
  2. SAS → third side; SSS → angle from cosC=2aba2+b2−c2​.SAS → 求第三边；SSS → 由 cosC=2aba2+b2−c2​ 求角。
  3. cosC<0 → C is obtuse; cos−1 handles it, no ambiguous case.cosC<0 → C 为钝角；cos−1 直接给出，没有两解问题。
c2=a2+b2−2abcosC
cosC=2aba2+b2−c2​

🧗 The hard part难点 · The cosine law余弦定理

Angle from three sides (SSS)已知三边求角（SSS）

Rearranging the formula and keeping the right side opposite the angle trips people up.公式变形、以及让对边和角对上，最容易出错。

  1. Sides 4,6,9: largest angle is opposite 9三边 4,6,9：最大角对着 9
  2. cosC=2(4)(6)42+62−92​=−4829​
  3. C=cos−1(−4829​)≈127.2∘ (obtuse is fine)C=cos−1(−4829​)≈127.2∘（钝角没问题）
Try试一试
Two sides of a triangle are 9 cm and 13 cm with an included angle of 118∘. Find the third side to the nearest tenth.三角形两边为 9 cm 和 13 cm，夹角 118∘。求第三边（精确到 0.1）。
Answer答案
≈19.0 cm

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · The cosine law余弦定理
  • 49+64−112cos50∘ as (49+64−112)cos50∘ → multiply first, then subtract.49+64−112cos50∘ 算成 (49+64−112)cos50∘ → 先乘后减。
  • Reporting c2=62.1 as c → c=62.1​≈7.9.把 c2=62.1 当成 c → c=62.1​≈7.9。
🎯
Mixed problem: cosine law for one piece, then the sine law for the smaller angle (never ambiguous).综合题：先用余弦定理求一个量，再用正弦定理求较小的角（不会有两解）。

cards.f: After finding one angle by the cosine law, what next?用余弦定理求出一个角后，下一步？
cards.b: Switch to the sine law (now you have a full pair), or use the cosine law again; then 180∘ for the last angle.换用正弦定理（已有完整的一组），或再用余弦定理；最后一个角用 180∘ 减。

quiz.q: A triangular lot has sides 52 m, 68 m and 90 m. The city only approves a building on lots of at least 1500 m2. Use the cosine law to find the largest angle, then decide whether the lot qualifies (area to the nearest square metre).一块三角形地的三边为 52 m、68 m、90 m。市政规定只有面积不少于 1500 m2 的地块才能批建。用余弦定理求最大角，再判断这块地是否合格（面积精确到 1 m2）。
quiz.hint: The largest angle faces 90 m. Area =21​absinC.最大角对着 90 m 的边。面积 =21​absinC。
quiz.ans: Largest angle ≈96.3∘; area ≈1757 m2≥1500, so it qualifies最大角约 96.3∘；面积约 1757 m2≥1500，合格
quiz.why: cosC=2(52)(68)522+682−902​=7072−772​≈−0.1092, so C≈96.3∘.cosC=2(52)(68)522+682−902​=7072−772​≈−0.1092，所以 C≈96.3∘。
